newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Sept budget deficit below IMF 1996 target.
newsitem.headline: Russia Sept budget deficit below IMF 1996 target.

text.p: The Russian budget deficit was 9.2 trillion roubles in September, or 3.8 percent of gross domestic product under the methods the International Monetary Fund uses to calculate the gap, finance ministry figures showed on Monday.
The September figure compares with a 5.3 percent deficit IMF target for the whole of 1996.
Economists agreed that the deficit was on track, but said this had been achieved by cutting expenditure sharply, rather than by bringing in forecast revenues.
"They are crunching back on expenditure and a pretty savage cutting of expenditure is taking place," said one analyst.
